summary: Shoshone County cabin on Thor Mountain, St. Joe NF: built 1930 and abandoned; FFLA lists it as gone; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: FFLA list says Gone; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say only that the cabin was abandoned, with no description of remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as Hike-In

events.note: Cabin, listed as 1930 on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.supports: 1930 cabin; patrol point one mile southwest atop Pinnacle Ridge; abandoned
evidence.quote: 1930: cabin. Patrol 1 mile southwest atop Pinnacle Ridge. Abandoned.

evidence.supports: elevation 6,384 feet; St. Joe National Forest
patrol point one mile southwest atop Pinnacle Ridge
evidence.quote: Patrol point – 1 mile southwest atop Pinnacle Ridge

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Thor Mountain in Shoshone County as Ground, status Gone; cabin not a tower

notes_for_editor: Gone status rests on the FFLA list alone; both detail pages say only abandoned. The patrol point is one mile southwest atop Pinnacle Ridge in both sources, but neither says whether the cabin stood there or on the mountain, so the story does not say. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives no staffing history and no fire history was found, so those are omitted. The Shoshone County Forest Lookouts list (idaholookouts.weebly.com/shoshone-county.html) has a Thor Mountain entry with no history lines, so it is not cited. Confidence is medium because only two short pages and one list describe the site.
